notes.pinball.view: The camera view's name (the table seen steeply from the player's end): shown as "TABLE VIEW" when the view changes.
notes.pinball.name: The pinball table's name, on its dot-matrix display. A made-up name: a run through a nebula.
notes.pinball.logo.top: The table's name painted on the playfield and its backglass, in two words, one above the other: this is the first.
notes.pinball.logo.bottom: The second word of the table's name, under the first.
notes.pinball.table: The title of the table's high-score table.
notes.pinball.shoot_again: Painted on the apron between the flippers: the light that means a lost ball comes back (the ball saver).
notes.pinball.insert_coin: Painted on the coin door under the table (a tall screen shows it).
notes.pinball.dmd.press_start: The dot-matrix display (128 x 32 dots, two short lines) in its attract loop. All its lines are short capitals.
notes.pinball.dmd.high_score: The display: the best score, shown on the line under it.
notes.pinball.dmd.balls: The display: a game is three balls.
notes.pinball.dmd.last: The display: the last game's score.
notes.pinball.dmd.ball: The display, under the score: which ball is in play (1 to 3).
notes.pinball.dmd.with_storm: The display: {status} (BALL 2) with STORM after it while the multiball runs.
notes.pinball.dmd.with_tilt: The display: {status} with TILT after it once the table has tilted (the flippers dead for that ball).
notes.pinball.dmd.with_demo: The display: DEMO before {status} while the table plays itself.
notes.pinball.dmd.ramp_lit: The display: the ramp is lit (the drop targets are all down).
notes.pinball.dmd.jackpot_lit: The display: the jackpot is lit (the ramp made three times).
notes.pinball.dmd.warp: The display: a ramp shot while it is lit, {ramps} of three.
notes.pinball.dmd.kickback: The display: the kickback in the left outlane saved the ball.
notes.pinball.dmd.jackpot: The display, big: the jackpot scored.
notes.pinball.dmd.star_storm: The display, big: the multiball mode (two more balls) starts.
notes.pinball.dmd.ball_saved: The display: a ball lost soon after launch came back (the ball saver).
notes.pinball.dmd.tilt: The display, big: nudged too hard, the table tilts.
notes.pinball.dmd.danger: The display: one more nudge and the table tilts.
notes.pinball.how.launch.touch: Help at the screen's foot while the ball waits in the plunger lane, on a touch screen.
notes.pinball.how.launch.keys: The same on a keyboard or controller (shown in capitals): {key:plunge} is the plunger's key.
notes.pinball.how.play.keys: On the title (shown in capitals): {key:start} starts a game.
notes.action.flip_l: The left flipper (on the controls screen: Flip l is flip left).
notes.action.flip_r: The right flipper (Flip r: flip right).
notes.action.plunge: Pull and let go of the plunger that launches the ball.
notes.action.nudge: Nudge the table (too much tilts it).

brief: The pinball slice: one table, NEBULA RUN (a space theme: a run through a nebula), after Pinball Fantasies and Space Cadet. Most of its words are on the table's dot-matrix display, 128 x 32 dots: two short lines of capitals, or one big word; keep them as short as the English. The player is unseen.
